title: Pocket + Shiv: Affliction into Killing Blow chain
question: Does Affliction (healing blocked) plus Killing Blow T3 (28%) chain more executes than Shiv alone?
hypothesis: H-B3-4.1 executes per Killing Blow cast >=2 with Affliction vs <=1 without. H-B3-4.2 T3 threshold (28%) catches the Afflicted targets where 18% misses. H-B3-4.3 no Afflicted bot heals back above the line during the 16s recast window.

arms.name: shiv_alone_t2
arms.notes: base order (Killing Blow T2), bots healing

arms.name: affliction_t3
arms.notes: Pocket Affliction T3 on the 3 bots, Shiv Killing Blow T3

setup.position: 3 bots within 10m of each other, each starting at 55% HP with regen on

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Shiv attacks normally and uses Killing Blow when a bot is under the line, recasting on each kill
Count executes per Killing Blow cast

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if affliction_t3 averages >=2 and beats shiv_alone_t2 with non-overlapping ranges. REFUTED: revert shiv_duo_pocket to the base order and drop the pair.
